coordinates: glTF +Y up; glTF (x, y, z) = (game x, game y, game z); Blender (X, Y, Z) = (x, -z, y)
normal_maps: OpenGL convention (+Y green up), tangent space

oak.note: atlas: u = plank column, v = 0..5.4 m along the plank; not a 2D tile

vertex_data.COLOR_0: masks: R wetness/slime, G lime/halo/runnel/efflorescence, B soot/grime, A moss (0..1)
vertex_data._AO: baked ambient occlusion, 0.6 m distance, 1 = open
vertex_data._BAKECOL: baked render base colour of the masonry (linear RGB), for reference or as a tint
vertex_data.UVMap: tiling UVs: 1 unit = one texture tile of the family set

images: not embedded: material ruien_<family> uses export/textures/ruien_<family>_*.png (see textures below)
